assignment.title: Soft Touch to Speed
assignment.note: Soft touches, quick feet—speed up only while the ball stays close.

drills.title: Toe Taps and Sole Rolls
drills.instructions:
Setup: Use a small clear space with the ball at your feet.
Alternate light toe taps, then use a sole to roll the ball a short distance forward and back before switching feet. Begin slowly and gradually quicken the movements if the ball stays close.
Focus: Touch the ball softly; keep your balance over it.

drills.title: Inside-Outside Touches
drills.instructions:
Setup: Stand with the ball in a clear space, leaving room to move it a little outward and inward.
With the active foot, gently nudge the ball outward with the outside of the foot, then guide it inward with the inside. Repeat with one foot for each effort, then switch to the other foot.
Focus: Make each touch small enough to keep the ball within easy reach.

drills.title: Close-Control Cone Dribble
drills.instructions:
Setup: Arrange four cones in a short, easy line with room to turn and return to the start.
Dribble around the cones and back, using both feet throughout. Start slowly; make the later efforts quicker only if the ball remains close. If needed, use the other foot to guide the ball around a cone.
Focus: Use gentle touches to steer around each cone without letting the ball run away.
